We just updated our website.
The Physics Department website was recently updated and includes a new site map. Search results in Google or other websites may still be linking to outdated web addresses, which led you to this page. We invite you to explore our new site using the menu. Until Google re-indexes our website, please follow these instructions for searching:
On a desktop: try the search bar included in the header. Type in your query and hit ‘Enter’ or ‘Return’ on your keyboard.
On a phone: click on the hamburger menu (three lines) in the header to open the menu and to display the search bar. Enter your query and tap ‘Return’ on your mobile keyboard.
